# Conclusions

The Data Section's activities in 2026 combined targeted technical assistance to CPCs, capacity-building workshops and cooperation with regional and international partners. These activities supported improvements in fisheries data collection and reporting and identified practical priorities for continued technical cooperation.

Further work will focus on supporting CPCs in implementing reporting requirements, improving data management and validation procedures, and addressing requests from IOTC scientific bodies. This section will be updated to reflect confirmed achievements and priorities arising from the 2026 data management and project activities.
